payload.summary: PR #537 was rebase-merged as 2a097935 after all 23 CI checks passed (dependency-update-remediation skipped); cleanup ran in post-merge mode from a --cleanup worktree. All tasks were complete, so nothing was migrated; the change was archived with its skill-workflow delta (1 modified, 2 added requirements) and the stale shared compact-pending-unknown.flag was deleted.

decisions.title: Rebase-merge PR #537
decisions.rationale: A single conventional commit whose message records why the flag is keyed on session_id; rebase keeps it verbatim for git blame, per the repo's agent-PR convention.

decisions.title: Delete compact-pending-unknown.flag only after the merge landed
decisions.rationale: Hooks run from the main checkout. Before the merge, every session still ran the old hook reading that shared flag, so deleting it early would have re-armed blocking for all of them at once.

decisions.title: No staged rollout
decisions.rationale: The change is a local Claude Code hook script with no service traffic or feature flag; the 5c/5d rollout gates do not apply. It is live for every session as soon as main is updated.

next_steps: Optional: garbage-collect old per-session ~/.claude/compact-pending-<session>.flag files (out of scope for this change).
